steps.en: Mobile numbers are obtained from DOS
steps.why_en: A contact lookup exists, but whether it is DOS cannot be confirmed and it skips court notices.
steps.why_id: Pencarian kontak ada, tetapi apakah itu DOS tidak bisa dipastikan dan notice court tidak ikut.

steps.en: Unique individual defendants are identified per batch
steps.id: Defendant individu unik diidentifikasi per batch
steps.why_en: Merging per recipient exists, but not for court summonses and not fully unique per phone.
steps.why_id: Penggabungan per penerima ada, tetapi bukan untuk summons court dan belum sepenuhnya unik per nomor HP.

steps.en: An SMS with court summons details is sent
steps.id: SMS berisi detail summons court dikirim
steps.why_en: SMS sending exists but no court summons content or trigger exists.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman SMS ada tetapi isi dan pemicu summons court tidak ada.
